heuristics.concept: 本启发式在现有积极经验的基础上进行优化，重点融合了“轻量级机会成本评估”与“动态稀缺性平衡”的核心思想。通过计算当前物品的相对稀缺性（价值占比与重量占比之比）作为核心评分，并引入基于剩余容量比例和位置权重的“动态保守阈值”进行决策，避免了复杂的冲突度模拟或贪心前瞻。同时，利用价值密度比对评分进行加权，增强对高价值密度物品的倾向性，并通过轻量级机会成本修正（检查拿取后剩余容量是否导致碎片化）对阈值进行微调。该方法在保持决策质量的同时显著降低了计算复杂度，尤其适用于大规模问题。
heuristics.algorithm:
import numpy as np

def select_item(current_index, remaining_capacity, weights, values, num_items):
    if current_index >= num_items:
        return 0
    w = weights[current_index]
    v = values[current_index]
    if w > remaining_capacity:
        return 0
    if w == 0:
        return 1

    # 计算剩余物品的总价值和总重量（从当前索引到末尾）
    remaining_values = values[current_index:]
    remaining_weights = weights[current_index:]
    total_remaining_value = np.sum(remaining_values)
    total_remaining_weight = np.sum(remaining_weights)

    if total_remaining_weight == 0:
        return 1

    # 价值密度
    density = v / w

    # 相对稀缺性指标：价值占比 vs 重量占比
    value_ratio = v / total_remaining_value if total_remaining_value > 0 else 0
    weight_ratio = w / remaining_capacity if remaining_capacity > 0 else 1
    scarcity = value_ratio / (weight_ratio + 1e-8)

    # 位置权重：越靠后的物品，决策越保守
    position_factor = 1.0 - (current_index / num_items) * 0.3  # 范围 0.7~1.0

    # 价值密度比：当前物品密度相对于剩余物品平均密度的比值
    avg_density = total_remaining_value / total_remaining_weight if total_remaining_weight > 0 else density
    density_ratio = density / (avg_density + 1e-8)

    # 动态保守阈值：基于剩余容量比例、位置权重和密度比调整
    total_capacity = np.sum(weights) + 1e-8
    capacity_ratio = remaining_capacity / total_capacity
    # 基础阈值随容量紧张而提高，密度比高时略微降低阈值（更激进）
    base_conservatism = 0.5 + 0.3 * (1.0 - capacity_ratio) * position_factor
    # 当密度比显著高于1时，降低阈值以鼓励拿取
    threshold = base_conservatism - 0.1 * min(density_ratio - 1.0, 0.5)  # 最多降低0.05
    threshold = np.clip(threshold, 0.3, 0.9)

    # 轻量级机会成本修正：检查拿取后剩余容量是否导致碎片化
    future_weights = weights[current_index+1:]
    if len(future_weights) > 0 and remaining_capacity - w > 0:
        min_future_weight = np.min(future_weights)
        if remaining_capacity - w < min_future_weight:
            threshold += 0.1  # 碎片化严重，提高阈值

    # 最终评分：相对稀缺性乘以价值密度比（增强高密度优势）
    score = scarcity * density_ratio

    # 决策
    return 1 if score > threshold else 0

    if current_index >= num_items:
        return 0
    w = weights[current_index]
    v = values[current_index]
    if w > remaining_capacity:
        return 0
    if w == 0:
        return 1

    # 剩余物品统计
    rem_weights = weights[current_index:]
    rem_values = values[current_index:]
    total_rem_weight = np.sum(rem_weights)
    total_rem_value = np.sum(rem_values)
    if total_rem_weight == 0:
        return 1

    # 价值密度与稀缺性
    density = v / w
    avg_density = total_rem_value / total_rem_weight if total_rem_weight > 0 else density
    value_ratio = v / total_rem_value if total_rem_value > 0 else 0
    weight_ratio = w / remaining_capacity if remaining_capacity > 0 else 1
    scarcity = value_ratio / (weight_ratio + 1e-8)
    density_ratio = density / (avg_density + 1e-8)

    # 位置权重：越靠后越保守
    pos_factor = 1.0 - (current_index / num_items) * 0.3

    # 容量阶段划分（总容量用所有物品总重近似）

    cap_ratio = remaining_capacity / total_capacity if total_capacity > 0 else 1.0
    if cap_ratio > 0.7:
        base_threshold = 0.5
    elif cap_ratio > 0.3:
        base_threshold = 0.65
    else:
        base_threshold = 0.8

    # 动态阈值调整
    threshold = base_threshold * pos_factor + 0.1 * (1.0 - cap_ratio)
    # 密度比优势降低阈值
    threshold -= 0.1 * min(density_ratio - 1.0, 0.5)

    # 轻量级机会成本修正：检查拿取后剩余容量是否太碎片化
    future_weights = weights[current_index+1:]
    if len(future_weights) > 0 and remaining_capacity - w > 0:
        min_future_weight = np.min(future_weights)
        if remaining_capacity - w < min_future_weight:
            threshold += 0.1  # 碎片化严重，提高阈值

    threshold = np.clip(threshold, 0.3, 0.9)

    # 评分与决策
    score = scarcity * density_ratio
    return 1 if score > threshold else 0
